title: Diabetic Retinopathy and Sickle Trait
brief_summary: To more clearly ascertain the relationship between ocular manifestations of sickle cell disease and diabetes, specifically; whether the presence of sickle cell trait exacerbates the disease progression of diabetic retinopathy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Self-identified African-American patients with diabetes will be identified from Dr Bowie's retina clinic at Storm Eye Institute.
* These subjects are either being screened or treated for the progression of diabetic retinopathy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: African-Americans with type II diabetes mellitus experience increased systemic vascular morbidity and mortality, even after adjustment for socioeconomic factors.
